scene: The bell chime summons a mechanical pigeon bearing a brass key.
picture: Along a tiled arcade floor, a tall carved wooden cabinet stands shut at far left. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands at center, watching a glowing mechanical pigeon holding a brass key on a roost at right. The brass bell hangs up high, and spiralling iron stairs rise at far right.
shown: a mechanical brass pigeon perched with a shiny key in its beak, right
a tall carved wooden cabinet standing firmly shut, far left
a spiralling iron staircase leading out of the arcade, far right
